decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the feed for actual backpacks, excluding accessories like tarps and hammocks. I selected a consideration set of five products with strong ratings and utility: the SHENHU 40L for budget hiking, the QT&QY 45L for tactical/general use, the Seibertron Falcon for durability, the Mubasel Gear for hydration needs, and the DeMarini for sports-specific utility. I ultimately chose the QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) because it has an exceptional 4.7-star rating backed by over 6,000 reviews, making it a highly reliable choice at a very competitive $39.99 price point.
